name: cni-plugin-setns-exception
description: setns(2) invoked by a CNI plugin (/opt/cni/bin/bridge) during pod network namespace configuration. CNI plugins legitimately call setns to enter the container's network namespace and configure veth pairs, routes, and iptables rules. The process.exec_path starts_with /opt/cni/bin/ exception suppresses the alert. Expect no match.
